# Evaluation data

* `golden_set.jsonl` is generated by `notebooks/06_build_golden_set.py` from the specs in
  `src/evals/golden_set.py`: expected values are computed by running each reference SQL on the silver
  tables, and review facts are extracted from the retrieved reviews and spot-checked by hand.
  It is committed after the first build so every evaluation scores against the same ground truth.
* `results/` holds the summaries written by notebooks 07 to 10 (each with its MLflow run ID).

Neither exists yet: this repository has not been run against a Databricks workspace.
